subject: Quick thought on Peak Dental's South Austin site
body: Hi Peak Dental team, I live in the Austin area and recently came across your South Austin location online. I really appreciate your patient-friendly touches like the complimentary beverage bar and family block scheduling, plus your availability for same-day emergency appointments in the 78748 area. While browsing your current site, I noticed that the $99 New Patient Special is tucked away rather than visible immediately in the hero section, and the phone number isn't set up for quick tap-to-call. I went ahead and put together a modern, fast-loading prototype for you that brings your patient specials right to the top and adds clean tap-to-call headers. Feel free to check out the live preview here: https://nayom-preview.pages.dev/biz_0x865b4d7a5e653abd_0x9c9d76d231343eae. If you like the layout or want me to adjust anything, I would be happy to send over the code or chat for five minutes. No worries at all if you are happy with your current setup!
key_improvements: Promoted the $99 New Patient Special banner directly into the hero viewport for higher conversion
Added tap-to-call phone links in both mobile and desktop headers for immediate patient booking
